notes.title: 🔥 New update available ! 🔥
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We’re very excited to bring you this update with features requested by the community, the main focus of this update is to make exploration more enjoyable, it includes :

🗺️ Addition of a map.

📡 Introduction of a radar item that allows you to locate hidden items on the map. This item is acquired after defeating the third boss.

🚀 Additional teleportation portals to speed up travel between areas and enhance exploration.

🗡️ Increase in the main character's melee attack range.

👹 Addition of an anticipation animation for the third boss's melee attack.

🛠️ Various minor bug fixes for a smoother experience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41028325/389034dceed9031b0193e3dc11ca516191c9408f.png
We hope you will be happy with these changes ! Update your game now and let us know what you think in the discussions! We can't wait to read your feedback !

notes.title: v1.1.0 Update note
notes.content:
Added a map.
 Introduced a radar item that allows players to locate hidden items on the map.
 Implemented teleportation portals to speed up travel between areas and enhance exploration.
 Increased the player's attack range.
 Added a anticipation animation for the third boss's melee attack.
 Various minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Speedrun Contest starts with amazing rewards !
notes.content:
Hello people,

To make our Kickstarter campaign more fun and interesting ! We want to start a fun speedrun contest for the demo of the game. The concept is simple: Start the demo and finish it as fast as you can. The contest is open to everyone, veterans and beginners.

Rules
- Record your gameplay session with a timer on the screen. You can use LiveSplit as a timer since it's one of the most popular with speedrunners

- The countdown starts the moment you press the "Start the Demo" button and ends the moment the Owl Knight dialogue STARTS

- Post your run on Twitter using the tags @KiroTeamGames and #kickstarterSpeedrun

- The contest ends on November 10th, 23h59 GMT 

Rewards

1st 
We have a special NPC in the game, the world's fastest creature ! A fun and engaging character with many surprises, appearing in different places throughout the game. 
As the winner, you can give him/her your name and be remembered as the best ! (You can name him/her differently if you prefer)

2nd and 3rd 
Get your name on statues of athletes in the character's village


So show us what you got, this little guy is eager to have a name
 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41028325/6f629f454d0a935c6712f840ec50d825eee5c595.png

 
Feel free to reach out if you have any questions or remarks
Good luck !
Idir
